newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end weak again, but seen nearing floor.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end weak again, but seen nearing floor.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed lower Monday, continuing a technical correction that followed weeks of strong gains, brokers said.
While some players believed the market would fall again Tuesday, most investors argued prices were nearing a floor and would start to rise soon, the brokers added.
Monday, the General Index fell 0.68 percent to 1,544.6 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index climbed 0.65 percent to 2,218.4 points.
In a total of 1,084 trades, 38 stocks fell, 30 remained unchanged and 11 rose.
Volume was a low 23.3 million soles ($8.8 million).
"There simply were not many buyers around. It seeems investors were waiting for the prices to egde down," said Carlos Guimeth of local brokerage Multivalores.

Among leaders, benchmark Telefnica del Per fell 0.52 percent to 5.76 soles, accounting for 25 percent of the day's total trade. Peru's largest cement company, Cementos Lima, closed down 2.02 percent at 4.36 soles in 14 percent of total volume. Miner Buenaventura fell 1.64 percent to 18.00 soles with eight percent of the session's volume.
